morphology.pattern_note: meN-在词根首音h前采用meng-，h保留。资料包把menghasut标作词根有误；此处依据DBP的hasut词条更正。[DBP词根及派生词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=hasut)

senses.zh_definition: 煽动；挑唆：激起某人对他人的愤怒或仇恨，促使其敌视、争吵或采取对抗行动。
senses.en_definition: To incite or instigate someone by arousing anger or hatred against another person or group.
senses.ms_definition: Membangkitkan kemarahan atau kebencian seseorang terhadap orang lain.
senses.nuances: 通常带贬义，强调恶意挑动情绪或对立，不能作为普通“鼓励”的中性替代词。可用menghasut seseorang supaya…说明被煽动者及其行动。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=menghasut)

senses.zh_definition: 唆使或驱使狗扑咬、追赶某个目标。
senses.en_definition: To urge a dog on, especially to attack or pursue a target.
senses.ms_definition: Menggalakkan anjing untuk menyerang atau mengejar sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》另收“驱使狗”的具体义；日常谈人际关系、新闻或社交媒体时通常使用第一义。下列为说明此义的例示搭配，未核实其频率。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=hasut)

collocations.en: to set a dog on someone

dual_scenarios.context: 职场通告：维护团队关系
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak pengurusan mengingatkan semua kakitangan supaya tidak menghasut rakan sekerja untuk memusuhi mana-mana anggota pasukan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 管理层提醒全体员工，不要挑唆同事敌视任何团队成员。
dual_scenarios.en: Management reminded all staff not to incite colleagues against any team member.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan menghasut dia lah, dia dah marah ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan menghasutnya kerana dia sudah marah sekarang.
dual_scenarios.zh: 别再挑唆他啦，他现在已经很生气了。
dual_scenarios.en: Don't stir him up; he's already angry.
spoken_features: 口语使用dia作宾语，标准表达可用-nya。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Jangan menghasut dia lah. Dia dah nak gaduh dengan Amir ni.
messages.ms_standard: Jangan menghasutnya. Dia sudah hendak bergaduh dengan Amir.
messages.zh: 别再挑唆他啦。他都快跟Amir吵起来了。
messages.en: Don't egg him on. He's already about to get into a fight with Amir.

messages.speaker: Haziq (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Okey, aku diam dulu. Biar dia tenang je.
messages.ms_standard: Baiklah, saya akan berdiam diri dahulu. Biarkan dia bertenang.
messages.zh: 好，我先不说了。让他冷静一下吧。
messages.en: Okay, I'll keep quiet for now. Let's give him time to calm down.

etymology.historical_story: The base hasut belongs to Malay's Arabic-derived vocabulary. A Malaysian Jawi teaching reference places it beside Arabic حسود, illustrating how a borrowed word can acquire Malay spelling and meaning. Malay then adds its productive prefix meN-, giving menghasut. Learners should distinguish this borrowing history from the modern derivation: the immediate Malay base is hasut, and the prefix supplies the active verb form. [MAIS language reference](https://mais.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2023/11/Edisi-MAIS-Bil.2.2023.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 记住“hasut挑唆，menghasut正在挑唆”：meN-遇h变meng-，h仍在，像有人不断添话把怒火挑起来。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说对方menghasut是较重的指责。需要缓和时，可先描述具体言语及其影响，例如Kata-kata itu boleh menimbulkan permusuhan。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于描述挑拨、激起敌意或煽动对抗。朋友间玩笑说jangan menghasut也可能表示“别怂恿我”；应结合语气理解，正式描述时避免把普通劝说一概称为煽动。
